This report describes completion of Phase I by the countries and territories in the World Health Organization (WHO) Region of the Americas during 2001--2010.
All countries exceeded the RCC-recommended 10% sampling minimum for low-risk facilities.

methods_quotes.q: A proportion of low-risk facilities (85.1% overall, ranging from 12.8% to 100% by country) was surveyed to confirm accuracy of classification.
Completeness of the surveys in all countries was assessed by a systematic quality-assurance procedure provided by WHO.
Countries were only required to survey >10% of these facilities to confirm classification.
